            placed = src_pod.current_node >= 0 and dst_pod.current_node >= 0
            same = src_pod.current_node == dst_pod.current_node
            movable = placed and not same and not src_pod.stateful and not src_pod.has_pdb and not dst_pod.stateful and not dst_pod.has_pdb
            if movable:
                src_node = state.nodes[src_pod.current_node]
                dst_node = state.nodes[dst_pod.current_node]
                src_peak = peak_of(src_node)
                dst_peak = peak_of(dst_node)
                pull_src = src_peak < 0.50 and src_peak < dst_peak and fits(dst_node, src_pod)
                if pull_src:
                    out.append(move_pod(src_pod.id, dst_pod.current_node))
                    moved = moved + 1
                else:
                    pull_dst = dst_peak < 0.50 and dst_peak < src_peak and fits(src_node, dst_pod)
                    if pull_dst:
                        out.append(move_pod(dst_pod.id, src_pod.current_node))
                        moved = moved + 1
    return out
